h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Vadodara

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Vadodara

c: Vadodara is a city of gardens, a large university and industrial estates, and it has long had an active morning walking culture. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Vadodara for housing societies, gardens run by the Vadodara Municipal Corporation, schools, colleges, corporate and industrial campuses. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 330 km away, so the machines reach central Gujarat by road over a short distance.

Summers in Vadodara are hot, the monsoon can be heavy, and the low-lying parts of the city near the Vishwamitri river have flooded in some years. We plan the base and location with that in mind. Our sales team suggests machines from your photos and measurements, and we send a layout drawing before manufacture. Installation is by our team or a dealer in western India.

richText.heading: Open gyms for societies and city gardens

items.q: Should outdoor gym stations be grouped or spread along a track?
items.a: Both work. Spreading them along a walking track gets more casual use, while a cluster suits people who want a full workout in one place. We can plan either on the layout.

items.q: What if our society is in a flood-prone area?
items.a: Raise the gym pad above the surrounding level, add a drain and grout the posts into concrete. Galvanised frames and moulded parts are not harmed by water.

items.q: Do you supply industrial and corporate campuses in Vadodara?
items.a: Yes. We supply offices, factories and campuses across India. Share the space and expected users, and we will send a layout drawing and quote.
